text: InvarLock training fixture alpha records a deterministic causal language-model row.
InvarLock training fixture beta binds optimizer evidence to immutable input bytes.
A real fine-tune performs forward, backward, and optimizer steps before saving.
A real LoRA lane trains adapter parameters before merging them into the base model.
Training receipts bind data, profiles, seeds, losses, model hashes, and tool versions.
Reloaded subject checkpoints must match the in-memory post-training model state.
Synthetic perturbations remain separate and never use fine-tune or LoRA-merge labels.
Tampered receipts and unchanged copied checkpoints must fail contract validation.
